snippet.title: Zero Tenshi: BLUE SUN — Short Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Download:
https://kuraishimi.itch.io/zero-tenshi-blue-sun

This is a game I made mostly to learn a little more about the Godot Engine, but I still wanted to tell a story. It can be quite confusing, but confusion is a normal part of this game's story. (If you've seen my Zero Tenshi videos)
It's a very slow, but relaxing game. I hope you enjoy it.
